question: Estimate monthly tile sales (vitrified + ceramic) in Gujarat — a state that's also India's tile manufacturing hub.
idealClarificationQuestions: Both manufacturing-side + state-internal sales? Both, but focus on state consumption.
Gujarat is the largest tile manufacturing state (Morbi cluster); separate manufactured vs consumed within state? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Gujarat tile manufacturing capacity (Morbi cluster): ~85% of India's tile output.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Gujarat production: ~125 crore sqm/year = ~10.4 crore sqm/month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Gujarat state tile consumption: ~8 lakh sqm/month internally + similar inflow = ~16 lakh sqm/month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Distinguish: monthly state production ₹4,500 Cr; state internal consumption ₹70-80 Cr.

calculationFlow: India annual tile production: ~1,500 million sqm (~150 crore sqm).
Gujarat production: ~125 crore sqm/year = ~10.4 crore sqm/month.
Within Gujarat, consumed in state: only ~6-8% of state's production (rest exported within India + abroad).
Gujarat state tile consumption: ~8 lakh sqm/month internally + similar inflow = ~16 lakh sqm/month.
